What is our profit margin by genre?

tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT g.Name AS genre,
       SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue,
       SUM(t.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS cost,
       SUM((il.UnitPrice - t.UnitPrice) * il.Quantity) AS profit,
       CASE WHEN SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE SUM((il.UnitPrice - t.UnitPrice) * il.Quantity) / SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity)
       END AS margin
FROM Genre g
JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY profit DESC;"}
